threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look bewildered when the 243 bus actually shows up on time. The locals just roll their eyes and keep scrolling.
Last night on the 137, a bloke serenaded the driver with an off-key rendition of 'Wonderwall'—even the drunk passengers stopped to listen.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I heard a full-on dance party spilling out of a backyard while I was waiting for the 171 bus. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the spontaneous dance parties in U-Bahn stations? It’s like the city's heartbeat - a rhythm you can't find anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot locals by their reaction to the Muni delays—if they roll their eyes and keep scrolling on their phones, they’re native.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton stuck behind a street performer doing magic tricks at Taylor. No one was mad; the whole bus just vibed with the show.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar in Gràcia serves 'tapas'—but half the spots specialize in 'pintxos' instead. Totally different vibe, totally different snack.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they struggle to find the right bus stop; locals know the hidden ones behind Plaça del Sol without a second thought.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's just a funky café with a name like 'The Grind' instead of a full-on coffee cult. Welcome to your caffeine initiation.
Caught the N137 last night; two guys debating if they could outrun a fox. Must've been at least ten minutes of serious strategy talk.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting in Körnerpark, I watched a group of kids play soccer while an old man painted the roses. That mix of energy and tranquility? That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find a club where the sound system is designed by an acoustics nerd who used to work in a car factory.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their reaction to the Civic Center Muni delays—rolling their eyes but still clutching a half-eaten burrito, like it’s just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 Fulton this morning—saw a guy using a skateboard to carry his groceries. Only in San Francisco do you get culinary creativity on wheels.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always ask for 'the best tapas,' but the hidden spots in local corners serve better dishes than the trendy bars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always ask for directions to Park Güell like it's a local secret, but we all know it's just a tourist trap.
